component.vulnerableCodeAssessment: libstdc++.so.6 and aligned operator new symbol are present. The exact vulnerable size-rounding/overflow sequence is absent: alignment is validated and posix_memalign receives the requested size unchanged.

upstreamFix.fixedVersion: not fixed in current Debian Trixie repository
upstreamFix.upstreamFix: No fixed Trixie package candidate; exact aligned operator new implementation takes the safe posix_memalign path.

findings.attackerControlledInput: Untrusted application/provider data may affect Node allocations, but no vulnerable size arithmetic exists in the exact operator implementation.
exploitPrerequisites: An attacker must cause a C++ consumer to request a sufficiently large aligned allocation through the affected operator new.
findings.reachability: The libstdc++ symbol is linked into Node; the exact symbol implementation is inspected in the final image by matching SHA-256 to the selected candidate. The overflow operation from the advisory is absent.
findings.networkExposure: Web is host-bound to 127.0.0.1:3000; worker has no published port.
findings.privilegeContext: Services run as UID 1000/node with zero effective/permitted capabilities.
findings.mitigation: Safe alignment validation plus posix_memalign with original size; no scanner suppression. Candidate package refresh unavailable.

vex.rationale: Evidence supports this proposed disposition for this exact image/runtime only. This proposal is not approved and does not clear the raw scanner finding.

component.vulnerableCodeAssessment: System zlib package is present, but exact Debian 1.3.1 source lacks gz_vacate; Node embeds separate zlib 1.3.2.1-motley-8002e91. Node source contains gz routines, but the v24.21.0 binding exposes deflate/inflate stream contexts and does not invoke gzprintf/gzvprintf. Node does not dynamically link system libz.

upstreamFix.fixedVersion: not fixed in current Debian Trixie repository
upstreamFix.upstreamFix: zlib commit df84af25dc1942490e1d1c899a07619152a46148; not backported in the exact Debian package.

findings.attackerControlledInput: Provider response bytes are untrusted data, but no application/provider code reaches gzprintf/gzvprintf or the system zlib gzip API.
exploitPrerequisites: The vulnerable path requires non-blocking gzwrite to stall and a subsequent gzprintf/gzvprintf call using stale input pointers.
findings.reachability: Exact Debian system source lacks gz_vacate; Node JS binding uses the low-level streaming API. No child-process or native-addon route invokes gzip C APIs.
findings.networkExposure: Web is host-bound to 127.0.0.1:3000; worker has no published port.
findings.privilegeContext: Services run as UID 1000/node with zero effective/permitted capabilities.
findings.mitigation: Vulnerable system function absent; Node gzip C entry points are not exposed to app. No suppression. Debian Trixie has no newer zlib candidate.

vex.rationale: Evidence supports this proposed disposition for this exact image/runtime only. This proposal is not approved and does not clear the raw scanner finding.

component.vulnerableCodeAssessment: mount and libmount are present; vulnerable X-mount post-hook code is present. Exact runtime fstab is empty except base comment; no external mount helper executable is installed.

upstreamFix.fixedVersion: 2.42.3-1 in Debian unstable; no newer Trixie candidate

findings.attackerControlledInput: The app does not accept mount command arguments or invoke mount; UID 1000 cannot modify root-owned fstab or add a privileged helper.
exploitPrerequisites: SUID mount call using a root-controlled, fstab-authorized external-helper entry and X-mount.idmap or X-mount.owner/group/mode; attacker must be able to use the authorized entry.
findings.reachability: The advisory-specific path is not callable by the app because required fstab entry/helper configuration is absent; exact image process inventory has no mount process.
findings.networkExposure: Web is host-bound to 127.0.0.1:3000; worker has no published port.
findings.privilegeContext: mount is SUID root, but app services are UID 1000 with zero effective capabilities; no fstab-authorized entry or helper is configured.
findings.mitigation: Root-owned mode-0644 fstab has no entries; no mount helper is installed; no app call site. No suppression. Fixed package unavailable in Trixie repositories.

vex.rationale: Evidence supports this proposed disposition for this exact image/runtime only. This proposal is not approved and does not clear the raw scanner finding.

component.vulnerableCodeAssessment: nsenter and --join-cgroup implementation are present; nsenter is mode 0755 and not SUID.

upstreamFix.fixedVersion: 2.41.6 or 2.42.3 upstream; no newer Trixie candidate

findings.attackerControlledInput: No app code invokes nsenter or accepts a process/namespace target; provider input cannot select a host PID or execute this binary.
exploitPrerequisites: A privileged operator must invoke nsenter --join-cgroup against an attacker-controlled target; the target must expose relevant cgroup state.
findings.reachability: No runtime invocation exists in web/worker processes; container PID namespace is private, CapEff zero and CAP_SYS_ADMIN absent from CapBnd.
findings.networkExposure: Web is host-bound to 127.0.0.1:3000; worker has no published port.
findings.privilegeContext: nsenter is not SUID; services are UID 1000 with zero effective capabilities; app does not automate privileged operator operations.
findings.mitigation: No --join-cgroup call path, private PID namespace and no CAP_SYS_ADMIN; no suppression. Fixed package unavailable in Trixie repositories.

vex.rationale: Evidence supports this proposed disposition for this exact image/runtime only. This proposal is not approved and does not clear the raw scanner finding.

component.vulnerableCodeAssessment: mount and X-mount.owner/group/mode code are present. Exact fstab has no entries and is root-owned mode 0644.

upstreamFix.fixedVersion: 2.41.6 or 2.42.3 upstream; no newer Trixie candidate

findings.attackerControlledInput: The app has no mount call path and cannot modify /etc/fstab as UID 1000; no mount helper is installed.
exploitPrerequisites: A root-controlled fstab-authorized restricted bind entry with X-mount.owner/group/mode; attacker must be able to replace the authorized source path or an ancestor.
findings.reachability: The fstab-authorized source plus post-hook operation cannot be configured or invoked by app-controlled input in this runtime.
findings.networkExposure: Web is host-bound to 127.0.0.1:3000; worker has no published port.
findings.privilegeContext: mount is SUID root but app services run UID 1000 with zero effective capabilities; root-owned fstab lacks authorized entries.
findings.mitigation: No authorized source entry, hook option or app invocation exists; no suppression. Fixed package unavailable in Trixie repositories.

vex.rationale: Evidence supports this proposed disposition for this exact image/runtime only. This proposal is not approved and does not clear the raw scanner finding.
